title: Risk-scaled source-margin release matched smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The 65k high-risk preservation failure is caused in part by a fixed normalized-advantage release threshold that disproportionately releases high-pot rows; scaling that threshold by the public risk weight should reduce high-risk boundary erosion while retaining some strong-evidence release.
material_change: Add a default-off option that multiplies source-greedy release advantage by the existing public pot/effective-stack risk weight. Compare matched 8k control and treatment arms with risk max weight 4 in both; only treatment enables risk-scaled release.
baseline: The prior matched 8k risk-weight smoke improved >=30bb drift, but the 69,236-hand scale run falsified that improvement: versus prior unweighted iter16, >=30bb TV increased by 0.00757, disagreement by 1.04 percentage points, and margin deficit by 0.00495. Fixed release advantage 1 remained unchanged across risk strata.

notes: Mechanism gate: treatment must retain nonzero released rows, reduce released-row count relative to control, pass tensor/session audits, and improve all three common-state >=30bb metrics (TV, greedy disagreement, source-margin deficit) without >10% aggregate TV regression. No internal strength panel or Slumbot in this smoke.

result.summary: Both matched-config 8k arms completed and audited. Risk-scaled release reduced released rows from 558 to 190 without eliminating release and improved aggregate source drift, but it failed every preregistered >=30bb mechanism metric.
result.conclusion: The implementation behaves as designed, yet scaling the release threshold is not a useful high-leverage preservation intervention under this training distribution: treatment-minus-control >=30bb TV was +0.0000181, disagreement +0.0000887, and margin deficit +0.0000412, all slightly adverse with intervals crossing zero. The mechanism is rejected for scaling; the aggregate improvement does not override the direct high-risk gate.
result.next_step: Stop iterating on source-margin preservation variants. Reassess accumulated opponent-league, Action-Q/counterfactual, and external-transfer evidence, then choose a qualitatively different learned-weight route with more direct policy-improvement signal; do not repeat an internal-only promotion chain known to mispredict Slumbot.
